profile.shortBio: I'm Anshuu Singh, a BCA student interested in software development, mobile applications and the way thoughtful technology can solve everyday problems. I enjoy turning ideas into working prototypes, exploring new tools and contributing to student tech communities.
profile.about: My journey is shaped by curiosity, hands-on experimentation and a desire to understand how products work beyond the screen. From exploring native Android development with Kotlin to building web projects and developing ideas for hackathons, I learn best by creating, testing and improving. I am continuing to grow my engineering fundamentals while looking for opportunities to contribute to meaningful products and collaborative teams.
